lines: Me
Ahh... As expected in the tropics, the sunlight feels different.
Squinting against the blazing sun, I headed out to the beach.
It was the day after the mission in the dark city.
Thanks to Revy and Yukikaze’s efforts, we successfully captured the horse‑headed demon and escaped the slums,
and managed to hand him over to the local authorities.
With the mission complete, all that was left was to return to Japan.
Still, we had a little spare time before our flight home.
So I decided to take a break and came to the resort beach near the hotel where we were staying.
Me
And… this sand isn’t the only thing that’s hot; the bikini‑clad ladies are insanely sexy too...
I swallowed hard.
Being a famous resort, the beach was swarming with scantily‑clad women.
Coming from a back‑water mountain village, the sight was a huge turn‑on for me...
Revy
Hey, hey? What the hell are you doing, jumping around like a dog!
Me
Wh‑!?
Revy
Well, look who finally showed up, Fuma. Perfect vacation weather, huh?
Me
Ah, Revy—
I turned around and saw Revy lounging elegantly in a beach chair.
Me
Sorry, I was a bit spaced out. The mission wore me out—how did Yukikaze and the others do?
Yukikaze and the other Gosha teammates should have already changed into swimsuits with Revy.
Revy
Yeah, they’ll be here soon. They were looking sleep‑deprived while changing, huh?
Me
Haha, I figured.
Being on an overseas mission they weren’t used to, Yukikaze and the others seemed pretty exhausted.
Me
Thanks, Revy, for staying with us until the very end.
I gave Revy a smile.
We’re flying back to Japan on the morning flight tomorrow.
It was a temporary goodbye to Revy—maybe that's why she's tagging along on our vacation.
She's terrifying when she loses it, but surprisingly motherly and easy to get along with.
Revy
Huh? It's not like I need thanks.
Revy
I was getting pretty fed up with the stinky sea of Roanapur, you know.
Revy
Sometimes it's not bad to act carefree and pretend it's a vacation—just thought so.
Well, just then Revy took off her sunglasses and gave me a mischievous smile.
Revy
Still, when it comes to you, I guess I should be grateful? You've been glancing at me all this time—
Revy
What's the matter, kid? Are you that fascinated by this Revy‑senpai in a swimsuit?
Me
N-no, it's just…!?
Teasing me, I couldn't help but stammer.
It was spot on.
Today Revy is in a bold swimsuit.
She proudly flaunts her sun‑kissed, wild skin, her firm breasts and hips adorned with a provocative red bikini.
Among all the bikini‑clad women on this beach, hers is undeniably the most stimulating—hands down number one.
But this isn’t the time to be thinking about that.
Me
S-sorry! My eyes just drifted…!
Me
But I’m not thinking lewd thoughts… no, only a little…
As I hurriedly apologized, Revy laughed joyfully.
Revy
Haha! No need to apologize. Kids getting horny is just natural. I don’t mind at all.
Revy
Well, if you start getting all pervy here, I’ll punch you hard, got it?
Me
H‑huh… Of course, I wouldn’t…
Revy laughed generously and allowed my lecherous gaze.
She clearly isn’t planning to get angry at kids over every little thing.
Even during this mission, Revy kept calling us kids the whole time.
Actually, that's true... but I wanted to argue just a little.
Me
But you always treat us like kids, Revy, and we're not that worthless either.
Revy
Huh?
Me
Well, as for me, I might still be a kid who can't do much.
Me
But yesterday, Yukikaze was taking down enemies just as much as you.
It was during last night's mission.
Yukikaze and Revy seemed to be competing over who killed more enemies, but in the end the contest was still undecided.
As far as combat power goes, they're definitely more than enough.
Revy
Yeah? You ninjas use weird techniques, so I can admit you’re decent fighters.
Me
Right.
Revy laughed and agreed—then her face turned thoughtful.
Revy
Anyway, aside from the kid thing… there’s something I can’t understand about you guys.
Me
Huh...?
When I tilted my head and asked, Revy glanced away slightly.
Revy
You guys fight for “justice” or “helping people,” right?
Revy
That part doesn’t make sense to me.
Revy
Those slogans sound so sweet and weak to me.
Revy continued calmly.
Me
You mean… our reason for fighting?
Revy
Yeah. We're parting ways today—so I thought I’d ask.
Revy
For me, fighting is just a job, a way to earn food—and honestly, it feels good.
Revy
When I blast away with my gun, I can forget all the hassle.
So fighting for others is nonsense—that’s what she smirked.
Revy
Well, there are people in my family who say the same thing as you.
Revy
Do people born in Japan think like that?
Me
That…
I opened my mouth while thinking.
Probably the “people who say similar things” are her partner, the Japanese rocker.
He also, though not purely out of altruism, sometimes acts beyond profit and loss.
And it’s often that Revy gets caught up in that trouble.
Me
…No, I’m not that noble or anything.
I laughed and shook my head.
Me
I don’t know about the rest of Gosha, but I do it because I think I should.
I wasn’t interested in whether my actions were just.
Just that there are people who are helped by our work.
If that’s the case, I don’t need a reason to act toward it.
And then, one more thing.
Me
The old me was called “Mebuke” and was looked down on because I couldn’t use ninjutsu… but that’s not the case now.
By doing what needed to be done, I earned trust from many people.
I gained a place to stand on.
I don’t want to discard this present me— I think that strongly.
Revy
“A place,” huh. I think that guy said something similar too.
Revy let out a slight smile and muttered.
Me
I guess I’m a bit childish… I thought that myself.
I scratched my head as I said it, and Revy gave a wry smile and looked at me.
Revy
Nah. It’s fine, right? That’s your way… if you stick to it, I have no complaints.
Revy
Well, I still can’t understand your ideas at all. But maybe—
Revy
Having you or guys like that around makes the world more interesting, that’s how I see it.
Me
Revy—
Revy’s words were both dismissive and encouraging.
Our positions, lifestyles, everything were different.
At that moment I felt like she had recognized me a little.
Me
(Well, maybe that’s just an illusion… huh?)
Yukikaze
Hey Fuma! Revy too! Sorry I'm late getting ready! Come on, let's play beach volleyball♪
Finally the changing is done, I guess.
Cheerfully waving their hands, Yukikaze, Aishu Hebiko and the Gosha crew headed to the beach.
Me
Yo, let's play, Yukikaze! Then shall we go, Revy?
Me
Today, you'll stay with us until the end, right?
Revy
Me, playing beach volleyball? ...Heh, I guess it can't be helped.
With a wry smile, Revy stood up from the beach chair.
